name: Two Leg Transaction Details 5
definition: Specifies the details of the first leg in a two leg transaction process.

TradeDate.name: Trade Date
TradeDate.definition: Specifies the date/time on which the trade was executed.

OpeningLegIdentification.name: Opening Leg Identification
OpeningLegIdentification.definition: Unambiguous identification of the reference assigned in the first leg of the transaction.

ClosingLegIdentification.name: Closing Leg Identification
ClosingLegIdentification.definition: Unambiguous identification of the second leg of the transaction as known by the account owner (or the instructing party acting on its behalf).

GrossTradeAmount.name: Gross Trade Amount
GrossTradeAmount.definition: Principal amount of a trade (price multiplied by quantity).

OtherAmounts.name: Other Amounts
OtherAmounts.definition: Identifies other amounts pertaining to the transaction.

SecondLegNarrative.name: Second Leg Narrative
SecondLegNarrative.definition: Provides additional information about the second leg in narrative form.

EndPrice.name: End Price
EndPrice.definition: Negotiated fixed price of the security to buy it back.

ClosingDate.name: Closing Date
ClosingDate.definition: Closing date/time or maturity date/time of the transaction.

ClosingSettlementAmount.name: Closing Settlement Amount
ClosingSettlementAmount.definition: Total amount of money to be paid or received in exchange for the securities. The amount includes the principal with any commissions and fees or accrued interest.

ProcessingDate.name: Processing Date
ProcessingDate.definition: Processing date of the trading session.

TwoLegTransactionType.name: Two Leg Transaction Type
TwoLegTransactionType.definition: Specifies the type of the second leg transaction.
